{{Quote|The War Hammer's attack has started!|Nyna Calixte|<ref name="Legacy 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>}}
'''''War Hammer''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]].

==History==
In [[137 ABY]] ''War Hammer'' was commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] [[Rulf Yage]] and [[Fehlaaur'aitel'loro]] and served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]]. The vessel, along with the [[Task force/Legends|task force]], was ordered with [[Operation: Thunderstroke|capturing]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and his daughter [[Marasiah Fel]] during their meeting with [[New Jedi Order]] representatives on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].

During the ensuing battle, the ''War Hammer'' destroyed the [[Dauntless (Pellaeon-class)|''Dauntless'']], a [[Empire-in-exile|Fel loyalist]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tohri Challon]], but failed to stop the Emperor's [[Defender One|shuttle]] from escaping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

The ''War Hammer'', with [[Vul Isen]] and [[Darth Azard]] aboard, later [[Devastation of Da Soocha|poisoned]] the seas of [[Da Soocha]] and attacked [[Napdu]], where the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]] had been hiding [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees from the [[Genocide on Dac|similar poisoning]] of [[Dac/Legends|their homeworld]].

===Defection===
{{Quote|Contact the War Hammer. Tell Moff Yage that, on behalf of the true Emperor, I welcome him back.|Master [[Treis Sinde]]|<ref name="War 4" />}}
The ''War Hammer'' later led a [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|strike]] on the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]], a secret Jedi refuge located on the planet [[Taivas]]. Initially Sith-Imperial forces attempted an orbital bombardment on Taivas, but magnetic interference from Taivas disrupted their targeting computers to the point that there were friendly-fire casualties while no damage was done to the Hidden Temple. The Sith-Imperials began a ground assault under the command of Moff Geist, and engaged both Jedi and Imperial Knights protecting the temple. Meanwhile Galactic Alliance and the Empire-in-exile fleets arrived and and trapped the Sith-Imperials between themselves and Taivas.<ref name="War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref>

Krayt chose than moment to deploy his personal force of [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]]. These arriving troopers attacked both allies and enemies, killing Geist and a large number of others on both sides in to the process. When ordered to destroy a ship full of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] by [[Darth Rauder]], Captain Yage instead killed Rauder and defected to Fel's forces.<ref name="War 4" />

Rather than kill his own daughter as ordered, Yage killed his own [[Unidentified Sith Lord (War Hammer)|Sith overseer]], and then announced that he and the crew of the ''War Hammer'' were defecting to Fel's forces. A number of other Sith-Imperial forces also defected. The Alliance, Jedi, and Empire-in-exile forces fled to Bastion with their new allies.<ref name="War 4" />
